name: She Has My Name
source:
You’re a young married man with a mysterious illness that keeps you bedridden most of the time. Your wife tells you to get your rest, but there has to be something you can do without getting up, right?

Each day you are presented with a choice: Attempt to make the best of your situation, or lie down and hope things might one day improve. With the Autumn Festival back home fast approaching, there’s no better time to get control of your life…if only you could convince your wife to let you go. 

[From [url=https://redsypanda.itch.io/she-has-my-name]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个年轻的已婚男子，患有一种神秘的疾病，使你大部分时间卧床不起。你老婆叫你好好休息，但总得有什么事你不用起床就能做吧？

每天你都会面临一个选择：尝试充分利用你的情况，或者躺下来希望有一天事情会有所改善。回家的中秋佳节即将来临，现在是掌控生活的最佳时机……只要你能说服你的妻子放你走就好了。

[来自[url=https://redsypanda.itch.io/she-has-my-name]itch.io[/url]]
